page.overview:
Who is Hound?

Hound is a Marine Vice Admiral and one of the nine that took part in the Egghead Incident.

He serves as a minor antagonist in the Egghead Arc.

Hound is a tall man with messy hair and square jaw and wears glasses with pointed ends and lipstick. He also wears a pinstripe double-breast suit with a dark blue suit and tie underneath it and a pair of black gloves. As a high-ranking officer he wears a Justice coat draped over his shoulders with blue cuffs matching the color of his suit.

Hound has a practical mind, as he is willing to delay drastic Marine actions such as a Buster Call in favor of addressing more pressing issues. However, he is also reluctant to believe ideas that come across as outlandish, such as the idea that the world could sink into the sea.
